levels.title: Roll to the Bowl
levels.goalText: Help the berry roll into Lory's bowl!
levels.teaches: plank: a tilted plank is a ramp
levels.hintText: The berry falls off the shelf right there... tilt your plank downhill toward my bowl and let it roll!

levels.title: Boing!
levels.goalText: Bounce the berry up to ring the bell!
levels.teaches: trampoline: bounces a falling ball back up high
levels.hintText: Trampolines love falling berries! Put it right under where the berry lands, and BOING — up to the bell!

levels.title: Tickle the Spikes
levels.goalText: Pop the balloon on the spiky spikes!
levels.teaches: fan: wind pushes floating balloons sideways
levels.hintText: The balloon floats up and bumps the ceiling. My fan can blow it along — point the wind at the spikes!

levels.title: Funnel Fun
levels.goalText: Catch the flying berry and drop it in the bowl!
levels.teaches: bucket: catches a messy fall and drops it straight down
levels.hintText: That berry flies all wobbly! My bucket has a wide mouth — catch it up high, and it drops straight down into the bowl.

levels.title: Domino Parade
levels.goalText: Fill the gap so the dominoes topple all the way to the bell!
levels.teaches: domino: chains topple when spaced 30-45px apart
levels.hintText: Uh oh, someone took three dominoes from my parade! Stand them in the gap — not too far apart — so the topple keeps going.

levels.title: Heavy Helper
levels.goalText: Drop the heavy marble to fling the berry up to the bell!
levels.teaches: seesaw: a heavy thing on one end flings a light thing up
levels.hintText: The berry is waiting on my seesaw. Hold the marble high above the OTHER end and let go — WHEE, up she goes!

levels.title: Berry Express
levels.goalText: Give the berry a ride on the moving belt to the bowl!
levels.hintText: The bucket drops the berry straight down — plop! A berry on flat ground just sits there... unless the ground MOVES. All aboard the belt!

levels.title: Balloon Boost
levels.goalText: Tip the seesaw so the berry rolls into the bowl!
levels.teaches: balloon: floats up and pushes light things from below
levels.hintText: Balloons push UP as they float! Let one go under the low end of the seesaw and watch the berry roll the other way.

levels.title: Balloon Round-Up
levels.goalText: Blow BOTH balloons into the middle spikes!
levels.teaches: combo: two fans, one from each side
levels.hintText: Two balloons, one spiky spot in the middle! Point your fans toward each other so both balloons slide along the ceiling to the spikes.

levels.title: Over the Wall
levels.goalText: Bounce the berry over the big wall and into the bowl!
levels.teaches: combo: trampoline to clear a wall, plank to land the catch
levels.hintText: That wall is TALL! Bounce the berry high enough to fly over it, then give it a little slide on the other side so it rolls into the bowl.

levels.title: Marble Catapult
levels.goalText: Roll the marble onto the seesaw to launch the berry at the bell!
levels.teaches: combo: aim a rolling marble to power a seesaw fling
levels.hintText: Start the marble on the high shelf so it gets rolling, then build a slide so it lands SPLAT on the seesaw's empty end. Berry, meet bell!

levels.title: Beach Ball Bowling
levels.goalText: The wind can't move the berry... but it can move something that can!
levels.teaches: insight: fans push light balls, and light balls push the berry
levels.hintText: My fan is too gentle to budge a berry. But a beach ball loves wind! Blow the beach ball so it bowls the berry right off the edge.

levels.title: Zig-Zag Sky
levels.goalText: Steer the balloon right, then left, all the way to the spikes!
levels.teaches: combo: two-stage steering — out from under the ledge, then back along the ceiling
levels.hintText: The balloon is stuck under that ledge! First blow it out to the right so it can float up — then use another fan up top to send it back LEFT into the spikes. Zig, then zag!

levels.title: Lory's Grand Machine
levels.goalText: Bounce, ride, funnel — build the whole machine to deliver the berry!
levels.teaches: finale: chain a bounce over a wall into a belt ride into a funnel drop
levels.hintText: Our biggest machine yet! Bounce the berry over the wall, catch it up high on a moving belt, and let the bucket do the careful drop — right between those silly spikes into my bowl.

notes: CONVENTIONS USED (apply these when loading the data): (1) x,y are object CENTERS. (2) angle is degrees, clockwise-positive, so a positive angle tilts a plank/shelf with its RIGHT end lower -> balls roll right; angle 180 on spikes means they hang pointing DOWN from a ceiling. (3) dir applies to fans and conveyors. (4) Floor-resting items sit slightly below the y=660 guideline on purpose: bowls at y=660 (assumed ~60px tall on the y=690 floor) and decorative floor spikes at y=678 (24px tall); everything else respects the bounds. (5) Bucket assumed ~120x90 with an open top near y-45 and a bottom hole that releases the ball straight down at the bucket's center x. All trajectories were sanity-checked with g ~= 970 px/s^2 (derived from '350px in 0.85s'), plank roll acceleration ~= g*sin(theta), and trampoline restitution 1.1x fall height; landing points have +/-40-60px slack against 110-130px-wide targets (bowl mouths, bucket mouths, trampoline beds, plank spans), so solutions tolerate ghost-placement wobble. DESIGN ARC: L1-L8 each teach one tray part with a one-gap contraption (plank ramp, trampoline bounce, fan-on-ceiling-balloon, bucket funnel, domino gap-fill, marble-powers-seesaw, conveyor-moves-what-won't-roll, balloon-lifts-seesaw). L9-L13 are two-part/two-idea combos with a single clean insight each: opposing fans herd two balloons to central spikes; trampoline-over-wall plus landing ramp; aim a rolling marble to power a catapult; fan can't move the berry but can move a beach ball that CAN (the game's best aha); two-stage zig-zag steering (blow right to escape a ledge, then left along the ceiling). L14 is a 5-beat finale (roll -> bounce over wall -> belt ride -> funnel -> bowl) using 3 part types. Goal-type mix: 7 catch, 4 bell, 3 pop. TUNING KNOBS if automated verification finds drift: the most sensitive numbers are bowl x in L1 (620), L10 (880) and L12 (850) — slide the bowl, not the solution; in L10/L14 the trampoline bed x (430/390) sets the whole arc, adjust it first; in L5 domino spacing is 40px (safe middle of the 30-45 window); in L2 the bell (505,255) sits on the rising leg of the bounce directly above-right of the trampoline — lower it toward y=300 for extra tolerance. Fans are always placed so their 280px reach overlaps the balloon's resting height under a ceiling/ledge (balloon center ~24px below the surface underside), which makes fan puzzles nearly placement-order independent along the wind axis.
